Input domain openfort.xyz; the company now operates at openfort.io. Wallet-as-a-service / embedded wallet and account-abstraction infrastructure (originally for Web3 gaming), founded Sept 2022 by brothers Joan and Jaume Alavedra, who went through the PearX accelerator. May 2023: $3M seed co-led by gumi Cryptos Capital and Maven 11, with Game7, NGC Ventures and Newman Capital. GamesBeat says it had raised $3.5M to date (amount_raised), presumably including the undisclosed Pear/PearX pre-seed. No later round found.
